-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Fixpoint.mkLeastFixpoint_is_least
theorem DY.Fixpoint.mkLeastFixpoint_is_least :
∀ {α : Type u} (f : DY.Fixpoint.Set α → DY.Fixpoint.Set α),
  DY.Fixpoint.IsMonotonic f →
    ∀ (set : DY.Fixpoint.Set α), (∀ (x : α), f set x → set x) → ∀ (x : α), DY.Fixpoint.mkLeastFixpoint f x → set x
:=
fun {α} f x set =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (implies_congr_ctx (Eq.refl (∀ (x : α), f set x → set x)) fun a =>
        Eq.trans
          (forall_congr fun x =>
            Eq.trans
              (implies_congr_ctx (Eq.refl (∀ (s : DY.Fixpoint.Set α), (∀ (x : α), f s x → s x) → s x)) fun a_1 =>
                (fun s a => eq_true (a_1 s a)) set
                  (of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (forall_congr fun x =>
                        Eq.trans
                          (implies_congr_ctx (Eq.refl (f set x)) fun a_2 => (fun x a_3 => eq_true (a x a_3)) x a_2)
                          (implies_true (f set x)))
                      (implies_true α))))
              (implies_true (∀ (s : DY.Fixpoint.Set α), (∀ (x : α), f s x → s x) → s x)))
          (implies_true α))
      (implies_true (∀ (x : α), f set x → set x)))
